enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.
Mortal Strike: On an attack roll of 20 which is confirmed as a critical hit this weapon triggers the Slay Living spell and attempts to instantly snuff out the life force of the enemy (DC 17).
Deadly +4: +4 Competence bonus to weapon damage.
Seeker +5: Provides a +5 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +5 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Deception +3: +3 Enhancement bonus to hit and +5 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.

Crystal: Crystal weapons are able to overcome the protective damage reduction of many Quori creatures, which can be resistant to other weapons. Spell failure chances for armors and shields made from crystal are also decreased by 10%.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
